procedure: Run the engineering-framework state checker against the current repository, classify every reported failure by historical protocol source, and determine whether an append-only repair can remove it without rewriting prior records.
classification: The 31 transition diagnostics are historical IN_PROGRESS-to-IN_PROGRESS events from A32 through A62.
The 36 artifact-reference diagnostics are absolute /tmp paths in 17 historical verification records.
The six enum diagnostics and five PASS-evidence diagnostics are historical REVIEW/RECOVERY values outside the current evidence-kind enum.
The gate-schema, gate-authority, and gate-history diagnostics belong to superseded gate records and the state pointer that still names the latest superseded gate.
The single reconciliation diagnostic is the historical A44 PARTIAL record versus its PASS gate decision.

disposition.reason: Removing these diagnostics would require rewriting or migrating historical records. No migration mechanism is defined, and rewriting append-only history would hide the recorded protocol state.
disposition.safe_action: Preserve the original records, keep the current A29-A35 evidence valid, and carry this residue as an explicit control-plane risk for a separately authorized migration task.

candidate_impact: No product source, private candidate, candidate fingerprint, policy, external-lane result, or release verdict changed.
